page_cues_note: LEDGER PAGE CUES (P35 T9, 2026-09-02). 'at' values here are RELATIVE to the page's own start on the timeline, NOT the episode clock - the page species adds the page start when it schedules them. Kept out of 'cues' on purpose: build_scene_timeline_f.py and render_episode.mix_audio() flatten every entry in 'cues' onto the episode clock. Gains = whoosh accent 0.9 scaled by the measured integrated-loudness difference vs fs-whoosh-1-706679.mp3 (-14.06 LUFS): 0.9 * 10^(-(I_cue - I_whoosh)/20). Whoosh accent exempt from the -28 LU bed rule and so are these (they are accents, not beds). All CC0 - sound/SOURCES.md.
